quotes.text: The way I would suggest this crowd start doing it is through AI. [...] Guess what? The technology in digital assets is the authenticator.

I believe the convergence of blockchain and AI cannot only improve the trustworthiness of data, but the decentralization of artificial intelligence data can mitigate single point of failure security issues and additionally as AI systems communicate with each other and need to transact with each other to obtain information, digital assets and AI can have that symbiotic relationship.

In many ways, AI has opened their eyes to the reality of digital inauthenticity and crypto ensures digital authenticity. [...] Of course it goes without saying that AI offers significant promises and benefits to our economy.

They're being told, oh, AI is going to destroy the workforce. People are going to lose their job. No, you've got to start putting the information together to show them that it's going to increase productivity.
AI gives us the opportunity to maybe accelerate that at warp speed. [...] I think the sky's the limit, and that's why you've got to make sure that we lead.

A data center in your town today is like putting a train depot in your town back in the 1800s. I mean, if you if you have one person, guess what, the business is coming through your town. If you don't have one, you're going to be watching.

So we do believe in local control, but it's going to be about information. [...] And we do need to make sure that it's local control, because if Congress gets in the way, guess what? More bureaucratic red tape from government does what, David? It slows and eventually stops innovation.

President Trump is absolutely spot on. Communist China and our adversaries would love it if the United States was asleep at the wheel and stopped innovating and developing AI and emerging tech. Thanks to President Trump’s work, the USA will be a digital LEADER!

Human beings are going to have to be involved. So the idea that A.I. is going to take over the world and run things like some sci-fi movie, not accurate. Do we have to be thoughtful? Do we have to be deliberate? Yes, we do. But what we're getting right now is we're in a race with China.
